enchantments.tooltip: Proof Against Disease +4: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural diseases. This item also grants a +4 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical diseases, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical diseases with a DC of less than 5 + their Fortitude save).
Insightful Strength +2: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +2 Insight bonus to Strength.
Doublestrike 5%: Passive: 5% Enhancement bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
Deadly +4: +4 Competence bonus to weapon damage.
Underwater Action: You have a +9 Competence bonus to Swim and can breathe underwater.
